answer: Every agent entering the harbor economy must lock a bond of 200 POA in escrow. A cipher key seals the bond and signs its referral, so the referral graph shows who sponsored whom. Peers may dispute any identity; if a fake cluster is confirmed, cluster and sponsor are slashed together. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA, each fake's opal bond burned. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and earns steadily, undiluted.
